text:
maria: FYI after last night's sticky-route rollout eu-prod resume telemetry looks off. console shows ~1% sampled, but post-ingest resume_event counts are ~0.1%. quota billing also missing resumes for some tenants.

jordan: yikes. do you have the aggregator query or example route? can we repro in staging?

maria: aggregator query: select route, count(*) from resumes where env='eu-prod' and ts > now()-1h group by route. console uses the x-telemetry-sample header to estimate sampled_count. backend uses post-ingest sampled boolean.

kevin: two likely causes: client sample-rate was recently lowered (2% -> 0.2%) and the fast-lb path used for canary cookies doesn't preserve the telemetry header. together you'd see a big gap.

ashok: correct. the sticky proxy also does server-side sampling before attaching resume ids, so header stripping matters. the console pulls the header, billing reads the ingest-side flag.

maria: that would explain the timing. plan suggestion: temporarily increase client sample-rate to 1% for canary, add a short-lived proxy flag to forward the header on fast-lb, and emit an ingest metric resume_telemetry_sample_fraction = sampled/total per route.

kevin: i'll patch fast-lb to copy x-telemetry-sample when Cookie-Canary=1. small change, will open PR.

jordan: i'll run staging queries once the proxy change is rolled. want to confirm parity before we change client config.

ops-bot: ticket INFR-2109 created: "fast-lb preserve telemetry header for canary routing" assigned to kevin.

maria: rolling the temporary sample bump to 1% for canary for 30m now. will monitor.

kevin: added console note + will add dashboard panel showing both header-derived sampled_count and ingest-derived sample fraction side-by-side. also propose adding presubmit replay tests to ensure header parity across proxy paths.

jordan: staging checks look good after header copy. post-ingest counts align with console after the sample bump.

maria: counts normalized ~0.9% after 12m. closing loop: root cause = fast-lb not copying header + client sample-rate change.

ashok: follow-ups: expose resume_telemetry_sample_fraction in default route dashboard, add rollout checklist item "verify proxy header parity", and add a lightweight replay test for headers in CI.

maria: filing follow-up tasks now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
